sql_templates.query:
WITH latest_dates AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS latest_date FROM signals.fii_dii_flows),
              latest_flows AS (SELECT * FROM signals.fii_dii_flows WHERE trade_date = (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_dates)),
              latest_regime AS (SELECT * FROM signals.regime_history WHERE trade_date = (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_dates)),
              latest_breadth AS (SELECT * FROM breadth.market_daily WHERE trade_date = (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_dates)),
              latest_index AS (SELECT * FROM market.index_eod WHERE trade_date = (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_dates) AND index_symbol = 'Nifty 50')
              SELECT * FROM latest_flows
              JOIN latest_regime ON latest_flows.trade_date = latest_regime.trade_date
              JOIN latest_breadth ON latest_flows.trade_date = latest_breadth.trade_date
              JOIN latest_index ON latest_flows.trade_date = latest_index.trade_date;
